description:
Top-Tier HK IPO teams at UK, Magic Circle and Red Circle Law firms are looking for junior Paralegals/ Legal Assistants for their growing Capital Markets team in Hong Kong. If you are a Paralegal with experience in ECM, IPOs and proficient in Mandarin, this could be an excellent career move for you.
Working alongside experienced Partners and Associates you will be actively involved on a range of Hong Kong IPO transactions.
You will have:

- 1-3 years of experience in ECM/ IPO transactions gained within a well-recognized law firm (International or Local). Expertise in drafting for HK and US IPOs and due diligence would be a plus.
- Bachelor's degree from a recognised law school
- Strong candidates with varied qualification can be considered for a future track and the opportunity for future promotion
The position comes with an enticing salary package, inclusive medical benefits, and a fantastic working environment with growth opportunities.
